_comment: Reviewed identity merges. A player's identity is the (organization, name) pair, so one person competing under several organizations becomes several entities that each start from the initial rating. Add merges here only after checking the candidate list produced by `npm run step:2c:alias-candidates`. Never merge on name alone: common names legitimately span dozens of organizations.

_format.canonical: { organization, name } - the identity that survives and supplies the displayed organization
_format.aliases: [{ organization, name }] - identities folded into the canonical one

_reviewNote: Every merge must carry "reviewed": true to take effect. Without it the entry is listed as skipped and ignored. The data has no per-person identifier, so a merge can never be derived from the ranklists: it is an editorial claim about who somebody is.

merges.reviewNote: Seeded by an agent from shared-teammate evidence. Set reviewed=true once a human has confirmed it.
